name: DXB Research Benchmark
design_note: A benchmark a model can answer from memory measures memory. Arm 0 is the model with NO tools; any task Arm 0 answers correctly is DELETED from the benchmark, not scored. Gold answers are written from primary sources and never appear in a prompt. Every `verified_by` marked `author-measured` was measured in this session with the command shown.

scoring.recall: fraction of the task's gold elements present in the answer
scoring.note: Recall carries the heaviest weight because it is the measured weakness of every system in this field, including ours.

tasks.verified_by: author-measured 2026-09-17: `opencli reddit subreddit-info ClaudeDesign` -> Title 'Claude Design', 23 837 subscribers; `opencli reddit subreddit-info opendesignCLI` -> 11. REPLACES the 2026-09-16 key, which demanded r/ClaudeAI (1 133 889) for a question about Claude Design and therefore scored 0 for the arm that measured BOTH named communities correctly and 1.0 for an arm that mentioned r/ClaudeAI only as context. That single task produced the 'the machinery lost its race' verdict; without it the gated arm scored 1.000 against the prose arm's 0.938.
